name: Natural Materials
summary: Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache needs materials to complete an endeavor, to be gathered alongside the other trials: splintered logs, encrusted minerals, resilient sinew and metallic fragments, taken from treants, mountain giants, faerie dragons, owlbeasts and hippogryphs.

sections.title: Gathering for the Witch Doctor
sections.body: After you return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i, a further list of materials awaits, to be collected alongside the other trials. Two splintered logs are needed from a Feralas treant. Six pieces of encrusted minerals are found on mountain giants and faerie dragons, westward. Twenty pieces of resilient sinew come from owlbeasts in the Hinterlands or hippogryphs in Feralas. A large amount of metallic fragments, forty in all, can come from any of these creatures.

sections.title: Uzer'i's Verdict
sections.body: When the materials are brought back, Uzer'i is pleased. Joined with the muisek, they should yield just the results that have been wanted.

faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.

faq.q: What creatures hold the splintered logs?
faq.answer: A treant of Feralas; two splintered logs are needed.

faq.q: Where can encrusted minerals be gathered?
faq.answer: Mountain giants and faerie dragons, westward, carry them; six are needed.

faq.q: Which beasts provide the resilient sinew?
faq.answer: The owlbeasts of the Hinterlands, or the hippogryphs of Feralas; twenty pieces are needed.

faq.q: Where do metallic fragments come from?
faq.answer: Forty come from any of the creatures named: treants, mountain giants, faerie dragons, owlbeasts and hippogryphs.
This request follows Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.
